algorithms: Map multibyte text through ANSI or wide LCMapString, preserving sort-key and required-capacity paths.
Compare multibyte strings through ANSI or wide CompareString, including zero-length/DBCS lead-byte handling.
explicit_argument_records: Actual eight/seven DWORD parameter slots have named fields. Positive length trimming and default codepage selection write their original slots. No synthetic CPU inputs, stack padding or merged fake buffers.

width_evidence.counts: Signed32; UINT codepage/flags and DWORD caches; CPINFO.MaxCharSize DWORD, LeadByte elements unsigned BYTE.

allocation: Two independent dynamic wide buffers per function; exact wrapped (count*2+3)&FFFFFFFC allocation. Only each allocation belongs to its own constant-1 SEH filter; Win32 calls outside it retain original propagation. No new zero-fill.

reused_dependency.meaning: Existing complete bounded-byte-count implementation, including native exhausted-limit probe; unchanged.

return_contract: Both physical entries use cdecl RET0 and full signed32 EAX. Thin adapters pass real argument-slot records to C.
qualifications: Shared strict build only; new native/C cases deferred to the cohort5 milestone.
Mapped stack with allocation guard headroom and valid Win32 conversion/CPINFO outputs; precise fault context/resumption is unproved.
Indirect callers, arbitrary asynchronous input mutation and malformed/unterminated external CPINFO ranges remain unproved.
